title: Focused source check of final Xitsonga Market assessment repairs
scope: Three specified Xitsonga Market L1 fields; read-only.

findings.result: June and July each year and the household vegetable shortage stay exact English; the short Xitsonga follow-up asks which action is useful.
The soil-fertility claim is exact-English held, retaining its role as the source’s false distractor without shifting “records” into the candidate wording.
“Records identify the gap” and “local climate” are held exact English. The surrounding Xitsonga retains crop choice/sowing dates, water, and expected harvest time as conditions.
All six language/lesson correct-index arrays in the packet match canonical; TS Market L1 keeps correct option index 1 for the seasonal question.
All TS Market L1 quiz[0] fields remain exact-English holds, including the R15/R18 example.

repairs.sourceEnglish: A farmer's records show she's short of vegetables every June and July. What's the useful action here?
repairs.canonicalSource: A farmer's records show she's short of vegetables every June and July. What's the useful action here?

reviewLimit: Source and semantic-scope check only. This does not establish fluent or learner-ready Xitsonga.
